name: Toraware no Mi
source:
Dark rumors were circulating about a brothel named "Kagetsu."
A ninja girl (kunoichi) named Natsume is sent to do an investigation of the facts.
However, she gets captured and she is subjected to a cruel sexual assault and training.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE058577.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
一家名为“花月”的妓院流传着阴暗的谣言。为查明真相，名叫枣的女忍者奉命前往调查。然而她却遭人俘虏，被迫接受残酷的性侵犯与调教。
